lessons.text: In the mail app, open /mail and click the message whose subject and attachment match the invoice, ignoring follow-ups without attachments. Download the PDF attachment before extracting fields.

To verify vendor email domain, call ERP GET /vendors?q={vendor_name} and compare the sender's domain from the invoice email exactly to the returned email_domain field. Stop and report fraud on any mismatch.

Before recording an invoice, check duplicates via ERP GET /bills?vendor_id={id}&invoice_number={invoice_number}. If a bill already exists, retrieve /bills/{bill_id} for status and skip recording; report existing ID and status to AP lead.

To confirm AP lead, open /mail/compose, fill To=priya.nair@kestrel.in, Subject and Message with vendor, invoice number, amount, bill ID, and payment date/status, then click Send and confirm it appears in Sent folder.
The ERP exposes GET /vendors?q= for vendor search and GET /bills with vendor_id and invoice_number query parameters; returned objects include vendor email_domain and bill ID/status.
